column1: # Polish (pl) catalog. Same format as zh-hant.tsv:  context <TAB> source <TAB> translation
# (empty context = a plain UI string; `@id` = a command id; `@plural` = "one|few|many" forms).
# Clean-room: every entry is written from the meaning of VectorCraft's English label, following
# common Polish desktop-software conventions (commands in the imperative: "Otwórz…", "Zapisz";
# menus and panels as nouns); no other application's Polish localisation was consulted or copied.
# Drafted with AI assistance (Claude) from the English meaning; not yet fully reviewed by a native
# Vocabulary: obszar kompozycji (artboard), obszar roboczy (workspace), kompozycja (artwork),
# ścieżka (path), punkt kontrolny (anchor point), uchwyt (handle), obrys (stroke), wypełnienie
# (fill), gradient, próbki / próbka (Swatches panel, a swatch), wzorek (pattern), krycie
# (opacity), przejście (blend), tryb mieszania (blending mode), ustawienie (preset), rozszerz
# (expand), uwolnij (release), obrys obrazu (Image Trace), linie pomocnicze (guides), tekst
# akapitowy / punktowy (area / point type), światło (tracking), interlinia (leading).
# Tools are "Narzędzie <Name>" ("Narzędzie Pióro"). Counts without a plural row read "Label: {n}".
# Coverage: every menu string, tl! literal, plural, status and error message (`untranslated_report` lists gaps:
# `complete_menus` and `COMPLETE_MESSAGES`). Left in English on purpose (`MENU_KEEP_AS_IS` in the
# tests): the product name, language names, OpenType, the built-in workspace names and the
# bracketed perspective grid preset names. Keep placeholders, ellipses and the leading/trailing
